items.title: New tab
items.description: Create and focus a tab in the current workspace

items.title: Focus pane left
items.description: Focus the pane to the left

items.title: Focus pane right
items.description: Focus the pane to the right

items.title: Split pane right
items.description: Split the current pane side by side

items.title: Clear pane name
items.description: Remove the current pane's custom name

items.title: Resize pane left
items.description: Grow the pane toward the left

items.title: Resize pane down
items.description: Grow the pane toward the bottom

items.title: Resize pane up
items.description: Grow the pane toward the top

items.title: Resize pane right
items.description: Grow the pane toward the right

items.title: Swap pane left
items.description: Swap with the pane to the left

items.title: Swap pane right
items.description: Swap with the pane to the right

items.title: Move pane to new tab
items.description: Move the current pane into a new tab

items.title: Move pane to new workspace
items.description: Move the current pane into a new workspace

items.title: New worktree
items.description: Create and open a Git worktree; leave blank for automatic naming

items.title: Open worktree
items.description: Open an existing Git worktree by branch or path

prompt.placeholder: Branch or path (use ./ for relative paths)

items.title: Remove worktree
items.description: Remove the current workspace worktree checkout

items.title: Edit scrollback
items.description: Open pane terminal history in your editor
